title: Summoning the egg in daylight after leaving the program

tellings.quote: Behind that, the egg flies by um in dead silence, makes a turn and comes around in to land and disappears behind the house.

plain: In 2024, out in the desert and in daylight, a former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says he called up "the egg", the egg-shaped craft he says he once lifted for a secret retrieval programme, and watched it fly by "in dead silence", turn and come in to land behind a house before vanishing. Barber tells it as his own experience after leaving the programme, naming Garry Nolan as a witness and mentioning the Pentagon's current UFO office, known as AARO. If true, it would mean such craft respond to human call.
